# S31 — Report the version with adj version

`adj` cannot say which version it is.

**Findings:** release prep; C169 · **Size:** S · **Tree:** cli
Cites: C165 decision: Release 0.1.0: an annotated v0.1.0 tag on local main; no remote, no push, C169 decision: adj version and --version report the version from build info, with an ldflags override

**2026-10-17** — From S26: TestUnknownLeadingFlag in internal/cli/cli_test.go pins adj --version to exit 2. Replace that case when --version is added.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

## Why

A release needs a version the binary reports (C165, C169).

## Files

- `internal/cli/version.go` (new): `adj version` and `adj --version`.

## Failing tests

- `TestVersionLdflags`: with the override variable set (in the test), `adj version` and `adj --version` print it and exit 0.
- `TestVersionBuildInfo`: with no override, the output comes from runtime/debug.ReadBuildInfo through a seam the test can replace: a module version prints as is, and `(devel)` prints with the VCS revision when the build info has one.
- `TestVersionArgs`: extra arguments are a usage error.
- The round-trip test builds with `-ldflags -X ...=v0.0.0-test` and checks `adj --version`.

## Implement

- Standard library only (C169). One output line, so scripts can read it.
